description:
Epii0-maintained patch release of the Apache Flink 2.3.0 flink-json module
		(Apache License 2.0). Changes versus upstream 2.3.0: exceptions thrown by the
		downstream Collector propagate unchanged instead of being misclassified or
		swallowed as parse errors, malformed records ignored via ignore-parse-errors
		are not emitted to the Collector as null rows, and the raw-input preview
		embedded in JSON parse diagnostics and debug logs is byte-bounded.
		This is not an official Apache Flink release.
